items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: No, I never did see Honoré or Peter. But, I do know that he played in a lot of the top brass bands like that.

ctx.x: Also, I was going to ask a little bit about your uncles. You had two uncles that played music. I understand, was it Peter was the violin?
Peter was the violin and the honoree was the drum on us.
How do you pronounce that? Honoree?
